part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：跟站长学提问 Have you ever…? 和回答 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.。
part2_desc: 第 25–36 步：独立做新调查，问答交换生的经历。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：现在完成时疑问句、肯定/否定回答、特殊疑问词。Unit 5 Educational exchanges 主题。

steps.title: 经历大调查
steps.teach_html:
上期节目播完，有听众留言：我也想知道交换生都去过哪儿！站长说：那咱们做一期经历大调查。

这期你要学会提问：“你去过北京吗？”还要学会回答：“去过。”“没去过。”

steps.title: Have you ever…?
steps.teach_html:
问“你曾经……吗”，把 have 放到主语前面：

Have you ever been to Beijing?（你曾经去过北京吗？）

结构：Have + 主语 + ever + 过去分词。

steps.title: 肯定回答
steps.teach_html:
回答“去过”：Yes, I have.

比如：— Have you ever been to Beijing? — Yes, I have.（去过。）

记住：回答里 have 后面不再加动词，说 Yes, I have. 就够了。

steps.title: 否定回答
steps.teach_html:
回答“没去过”：No, I haven't.（haven't = have not）

— Have you ever been to Beijing? — No, I haven't.（没去过。）

也可以说：No, never.（没有，从没去过。）

steps.title: 问 he/she
steps.teach_html:
问“他/她”时，用 Has 开头：

Has he ever eaten dumplings?（他曾经吃过饺子吗？）

回答：Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.

口诀：问句开头看主语，三单用 Has。

steps.title: 特殊疑问词
steps.teach_html:
想问“去过哪儿”“做过什么”，把特殊疑问词放最前面：

Where have you been?（你去过哪儿？）

What have you done?（你做过什么？）

steps.title: Who 提问
steps.teach_html:
问“谁”，用 Who has…?：

Who has been to Shanghai?（谁去过上海？）

回答：Li Ming has.（李明去过。）

steps.title: yet：用于疑问句
steps.teach_html:
yet 还可以放在疑问句末尾，表示“已经……了吗”：

Have you finished yet?（你做完了吗？）

注意：yet 在疑问句里是“已经”，在否定句里是“还没”，看句子来定。

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 过去分词提问；回答 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

下面站长带着你练。资料卡在上面，做题时对照着看。

steps.title: 先看资料
steps.teach_html:
这是调查表。做题时对照着看：李明—去过北京—没出过国；安娜—去过上海—吃过饺子；汤姆—见过长城—没去过上海。

下面练提问和回答。
steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: 你去过北京吗
steps.scene: 问李明去过北京吗。
steps.stem: ______ you ever been to Beijing?
steps.explain: Have you ever been to Beijing?

wrong_feedback.B: Has 用于 he/she/it。you 用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Do 是一般现在时，这里是现在完成时，用 Have。
wrong_feedback.D: Are 是 be 动词，不对。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: you 不是第三人称单数，句首用 Have，不用 Has。
Do 是一般现在时提问用的；问经历是现在完成时，用 Have。
Are 是 be 动词，不能这样问经历；要用 Have you ever been…？

steps.title: 他吃过饺子吗
steps.scene: 问安娜吃过饺子吗。
steps.stem: ______ Anna ever eaten dumplings?

wrong_feedback.A: Have 用于 I/you/we/they。Anna 是三单，用 Has。
wrong_feedback.B: Do 是一般现在时，不对。
wrong_feedback.D: Does 是一般现在时三单，不对。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: Anna 是一人（第三人称单数），句首用 Has，不用 Have。
Does 是一般现在时三单，后面跟不了 eaten；完成时用 Has。
Do 配非三单主语，而且是一般现在时；这里用 Has。

steps.title: 肯定回答
steps.scene: 李明去过北京，他怎么答？
steps.stem: — Have you ever been to Beijing? — Yes, ______.

wrong_feedback.A: I do 是一般现在时的回答，这里用 I have。
wrong_feedback.C: I am 是 be 动词，不对。
wrong_feedback.D: me too 是“我也是”，不是回答“去过”。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: 问题用 Have 提问，回答也要对上：Yes, I have。
am 是 be 动词，不能回答完成时的问题。
me too 是'我也一样'，不是对'你去过吗'的回答。

steps.title: 否定回答
steps.scene: 汤姆没去过上海，他怎么答？
steps.stem: — Have you ever been to Shanghai? — No, ______.

wrong_feedback.A: I don't 是一般现在时否定，这里用 I haven't。
wrong_feedback.B: I am not 是 be 动词否定，不对。
wrong_feedback.C: I no 不是完整回答。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: don't 是一般现在时的否定；完成时的否定回答用 haven't。
这是 be 动词的否定，跟完成时的问题对不上。
'I no'不是完整的英语回答，要说 No, I haven't。

steps.title: 去过哪儿
steps.scene: 问安娜去过哪儿。
steps.stem: ______ has Anna been?

wrong_feedback.B: When 问时间，这里问地点。
wrong_feedback.C: What 问什么，这里问“哪儿”。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: When 问时间，这里问的是去过哪儿（地点），用 Where。
What 问事物，这里问地点，用 Where。
Who 问人，这里问地点，用 Where。

steps.title: 谁去过
steps.scene: 问谁见过长城。
steps.stem: ______ has seen the Great Wall?
steps.explain: Who has seen the Great Wall?
steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: Where 问地点，这里问'谁'见过长城，用 Who。
What 问事物，这里问人，用 Who。
When 问时间，这里问人，用 Who。

steps.title: 做完了吗
steps.scene: 问他做完作业了吗。
steps.stem: Have you finished your homework ______?
steps.help: 疑问句末尾表示“已经……了吗”，用什么？
steps.explain: Have you finished your homework yet?

wrong_feedback.A: already 一般不放疑问句末，这里用 yet。
wrong_feedback.B: ever 是“曾经”，这里问“做完了吗”，用 yet。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: already 一般用于肯定句；疑问句句末用 yet。
ever 问'曾经'，放在主语后面；句末问'做完了吗'用 yet。
never 是'从不'，放这里意思不对。

steps.title: 她去过吗
steps.scene: 她去过上海吗？去过。
steps.stem: — Has she ever been to Shanghai? — ______.

wrong_feedback.C: does 是一般现在时，不对。
wrong_feedback.D: is 是 be 动词，不对。
wrong_feedback.B: she 是第三人称单数，肯定回答要用 has，不能用 have：Yes, she has。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: she 是第三人称单数，have 要变成 has：Yes, she has。
does 是一般现在时；Has 提问的问题要用 has 回答。
is 是 be 动词，不能回答现在完成时的问题。

common_errors.when: 回答和问题用的助动词不一样
common_errors.say: 回答要和问题对上：问题用 Has，回答就用 has。

steps.title: 没去过
steps.scene: 他没去过北京。
steps.stem: He has ______ been to Beijing.
steps.explain: He has never been to Beijing.

wrong_feedback.B: ever 是“曾经”，这里要“从没”，用 never。
wrong_feedback.C: yet 放句末，这里用 never。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

common_errors.say: ever 是'曾经'，这里要表达'从来没去过'，用 never。
yet 一般放疑问句或否定句的句末，这里用 never。
already 是'已经'，和'没去过'意思正好相反。

steps.title: 写出过去分词：do
steps.scene: 把 do 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 do 的过去分词。

common_errors.say: did 是过去式，过去分词是 done。
do 是不规则动词，不能加 -ed；过去分词是 done。
doing 是现在分词，这里要过去分词 done。
does 是三单现在时，过去分词是 done。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: have 还是 has
steps.scene: 你曾经去过吗？
steps.stem: ___ you ever been there?

common_errors.say: you 用 Have，不用 Has。
Do 问的是一般现在时；问经历用完成时，句首用 Have。
Are 是 be 动词，跟不了 been 提问经历；用 Have。
Does 只配三单主语，you 不是三单，用 Have。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: have 还是 has
steps.scene: 他曾经去过吗？
steps.stem: ___ he ever been there?

common_errors.say: he 是三单，用 Has。
Does 是一般现在时三单；问经历用完成时 Has。
Is 是 be 动词，跟不了 been 组成完成时提问；用 Has。
Do 用在非三单主语；he 是三单，完成时用 Has。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: 否定缩写
steps.scene: 写出 have not 的缩写。
steps.stem: 写出 have not 的缩写形式。

common_errors.say: 别忘了撇号：haven't。
hasn't 是 has not 的缩写；have not 的缩写是 haven't，别混。
缩写要把 o 换成撇号：have not → haven't。
撇号放在 n 和 t 中间：haven't。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: 写出过去分词：be
steps.scene: 把 be 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 be 的过去分词。

common_errors.say: was 是过去式，过去分词是 been。
being 是现在分词，过去分词是 been。
were 是过去式，过去分词是 been，别把两个混了。
be 完全不规则，没有 beed 这个词；过去分词是 been。

steps.reading: Survey: Li Ming has been to Beijing, has never been abroad; Anna has been to Shanghai, has eaten dumplings; Tom has seen the Great Wall, hasn't been to Shanghai

steps.title: 新任务：独立调查
steps.teach_html:
新任务：这次是小梅 (Mei)、杰克 (Jack)、莉莉 (Lily) 的新调查表。

资料在上面。这次你自己问、自己答，站长不提示了。

记住：Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 过去分词提问；Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. 回答。
steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

steps.title: 她去过杭州吗
steps.scene: 问小梅去过杭州吗。
steps.stem: ______ Mei ever been to Hangzhou?
steps.explain: Has Mei ever been to Hangzhou?

wrong_feedback.A: Mei 是一人（第三人称单数），现在完成时疑问句句首用 Has，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.B: Do 是一般现在时提问用的；这里问的是有没有过这段经历，是现在完成时，要用 Has。
wrong_feedback.C: Does 后面要跟动词原形，跟不了 been；完成时疑问句用 Has 开头。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: Mei 是一人（第三人称单数），句首用 Has。
Do 是一般现在时；问经历是现在完成时，用 Has。
Does 后面跟动词原形，跟不了 been；用 Has。

steps.title: 他吃过面条吗
steps.scene: 杰克吃过面条，他怎么答？
steps.stem: — Has he ever eaten noodles? — Yes, ______.

wrong_feedback.A: 回答要和问题对上：问题用 Has 提问，回答就用 has，'he do'不对。
wrong_feedback.C: is 是 be 动词，不能用来回答完成时的问题；要用 he has。
wrong_feedback.D: does 是一般现在时的回答，可问题问的是经历（现在完成时），要用 he has。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: 回答要和问题对上：Has 提问，回答就用 has。
is 是 be 动词，不能回答完成时问题；用 he has。
does 是一般现在时的回答；问题问经历，要用 he has。

steps.title: 她没出过国
steps.scene: 小梅没出过国，她怎么答？
steps.stem: — Have you ever been abroad? — No, ______.

wrong_feedback.A: don't 是一般现在时的否定；问题是现在完成时（Have you…），否定回答要用 haven't。
wrong_feedback.B: I am not 是 be 动词的否定，跟完成时的问题对不上；用 I haven't。
wrong_feedback.D: 'I no'不是英语里的说法，否定回答要完整：No, I haven't。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: don't 是一般现在时否定；完成时否定回答用 I haven't。
be 动词的否定对不上完成时的问题；用 I haven't。
'I no'不是完整的英语回答。

steps.title: 她学过什么
steps.scene: 问莉莉学过什么。
steps.stem: ______ has Lily learned?

wrong_feedback.B: Where 问地点，可 learned 后面缺的是'学的东西'，问'什么'用 What。
wrong_feedback.C: Who 问人，这里问的是学的内容，不是问谁，用 What。
wrong_feedback.D: When 问时间，这里问学了什么，用 What。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: Where 问地点；learned 后面缺的是内容，问'什么'用 What。
Who 问人，这里问学的内容，用 What。
When 问时间，这里问内容，用 What。

steps.title: 做完作业了吗
steps.scene: 问他做完作业了吗。
steps.stem: Has he finished his homework ______?
steps.explain: Has he finished his homework yet?

wrong_feedback.A: already 多用于肯定句；疑问句句末问'……了吗'用 yet。
wrong_feedback.B: ever 是'曾经'，位置在主语后面、动词前面，不放句末；这里用 yet。
wrong_feedback.C: never 是'从不'，意思不对；问'做完了吗'句末用 yet。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: already 多用于肯定句；疑问句句末用 yet。
ever 放在主语后面，不放句末；这里用 yet。
never 是'从不'，意思不对。

steps.title: 谁没见过雪
steps.scene: 问谁没见过雪。
steps.stem: ______ has never seen snow?

wrong_feedback.A: Where 问地点，这里问的是'谁'没见过雪，用 Who。
wrong_feedback.C: What 问事物，这里问人，用 Who。
wrong_feedback.D: When 问时间，这里问人，用 Who。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

common_errors.say: Where 问地点，这里问'谁'，用 Who。
What 问事物，这里问人，用 Who。
When 问时间，这里问人，用 Who。

steps.title: 写出过去分词：make
steps.scene: 把 make 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 make 的过去分词。

common_errors.say: make 不规则，过去分词是 made。
making 是现在分词，过去分词是 made。
makes 是三单现在时，过去分词是 made。
没有 maden 这个词；make 的过去分词和过去式一样，都是 made。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

steps.title: has not 的缩写
steps.scene: 写出 has not 的缩写。
steps.stem: 写出 has not 的缩写形式。

common_errors.say: 别忘了撇号：hasn't。
haven't 是 have not 的缩写；has not 的缩写是 hasn't。
缩写要用撇号代替 o：has not → hasn't。
撇号放在 n 和 t 中间：hasn't。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

steps.title: have 还是 has
steps.scene: 他们曾经去过吗？
steps.stem: ___ they ever been there?

common_errors.say: they 用 Have。
Do 是一般现在时；问经历用完成时 Have。
Are 跟不了 been 提问经历；用 Have they ever been…？
Does 只配三单主语，they 不是三单，用 Have。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

steps.title: 写出过去分词：take
steps.scene: 把 take 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 take 的过去分词。

common_errors.say: take 不规则，过去分词是 taken。
took 是过去式；过去分词是 taken，结尾多一个 n。
taking 是现在分词，过去分词是 taken。
takes 是三单现在时，过去分词是 taken。

steps.reading: New survey: Mei has been to Hangzhou, hasn't been abroad; Jack has eaten noodles, has never seen snow; Lily has learned dancing for two years

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
调查做得很清楚。站长说：提问回答都会了。

下一期，站长要讲just、already、yet——“我刚到”“我已经吃过了”“我还没做完”，英文怎么说。

steps.title: 挑战 · 爸爸去过吗
steps.scene: 问爸爸参观过博物馆没有。
steps.stem: ______ your father ever visited a museum?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个人，还是多个人？
steps.explain: Has your father ever visited a museum?

common_errors.say: your father 是一人（第三人称单数），句首要用 Has，不用 Have。
Does 是一般现在时，后面跟不了 visited；问经历用完成时 Has。
Is 是 be 动词，不能这样提问经历；用 Has。
Do 配非三单主语，而且是一般现在时；这里用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 陈老师教过吗
steps.scene: 回答站长的问题，只写最后一个词。
steps.stem: — Has Mr Chen ever taught English? — Yes, he ______.
steps.help: 回答要和问题对上：问题句首用的哪一类词，回答里就用它的对应形式。

common_errors.say: he 是第三人称单数，回答用 has，不用 have。
does 是一般现在时的回答；问题是完成时（Has…），回答用 has。
is 是 be 动词，不能回答完成时的问题。
简短回答只留助动词：Yes, he has. 后面不用再加 been。

steps.title: 挑战 · 这里下过雪吗
steps.scene: 回答问题，只写最后一个词。
steps.stem: — Has it ever snowed here? — No, it ______.
steps.help: 先看主语是单数还是复数，再想否定要把哪个词和 not 缩在一起。

common_errors.say: it 是第三人称单数，has not 缩写是 hasn't；haven't 是 have not 的。
isn't 是 be 动词的否定，对不上 Has 提问的问题。
doesn't 是一般现在时的否定；完成时的否定回答用 hasn't。
光写 not 不完整，要和 has 缩成一个词：hasn't。

steps.title: 挑战 · 爷爷奶奶出过国吗
steps.scene: 问爷爷奶奶有没有在国外生活过。
steps.stem: ______ your grandparents ever lived abroad?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个人，还是多个人？
steps.explain: Have your grandparents ever lived abroad?

wrong_feedback.B: your grandparents 是两个人（复数），句首用 Have，不用 Has。
wrong_feedback.C: Does 是一般现在时，后面跟不了 lived；问经历用完成时 Have。
wrong_feedback.D: Is 是 be 动词，不能这样提问经历；用 Have。

steps.title: 挑战 · 滑过雪吗
steps.scene: 回答站长的问题，只写空里的词。
steps.stem: — Have you ever tried skiing? — No, I have ______ tried it.
steps.help: 回答是 No，后半句要表达'从来没有过'，想想哪个词是这个意思。
steps.explain: No, I have never tried it.

common_errors.say: ever 是'曾经'，意思对不上；这里说'从来没试过'，用 never。
yet 一般放句末，不放 have 后面；这里用 never。
already 是'已经'，意思正好反了；'从来没有'用 never。
have 后面直接放 not 不成句；表达'从来没有'用 never。

steps.title: 挑战 · 去过农场吗
steps.scene: 问同桌去过农场没有，只写空里的词。
steps.stem: Have you ______ been to a farm?
steps.help: 这是问'曾经……过吗'，想想提问时表示'曾经'的词是哪一个。
steps.explain: Have you ever been to a farm?

common_errors.say: never 用在陈述句里表示'从来没有'，不能拿来提问；提问用 ever。
yet 放句末问'做完了吗'，不问经历；这里用 ever。
already 一般用于肯定句，问经历要用 ever。
once 是'一次'，问'曾经去过吗'要用 ever。

steps.title: 挑战 · 这座桥哪年建的
steps.scene: 回锅 Unit 4：问这座桥是不是 2010 年建成的。
steps.stem: ______ the bridge built in 2010?
steps.help: 先想：桥是自己建的，还是被人建的？再看时间：2010 年是过去还是现在？

wrong_feedback.A: Does 后面要跟动词原形，跟不了 built；桥是被建的，要用被动语态提问。
wrong_feedback.B: Has 是现在完成时，不能这样问'被建'；被动语态提问要用 be 动词 Was。
wrong_feedback.D: Is 是现在时的 be 动词，可 2010 年是过去的事，要用过去式 Was。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最高的一座山
steps.scene: 回锅 Unit 3：这一带所有的山里，这座是最高的。
steps.stem: Of all the mountains in this area, this one is the ______.
steps.help: 先看范围：是两座比，还是'所有里面最……'？再看前面有没有 the。
steps.explain: Of all the mountains in this area, this one is the highest.

wrong_feedback.A: higher 是比较级，用在两者比较时；这里是'所有里面最高的'，用最高级 highest。
wrong_feedback.C: high 是原级；前面有 the、又有'所有的山'这个范围，要用最高级 the highest。
wrong_feedback.D: high 是短单词，变最高级直接加 -est，没有 more high 这种说法。

title: 你去过吗：疑问句和回答
